events.title: Study of 117-Year-Old Reveals Simultaneous Extreme Aging and Youth
events.one_liner: A comprehensive multi-omic study of Maria Branyas, who lived to 117, revealed she simultaneously exhibited extreme aging markers and powerful biological protection mechanisms. The research suggests extreme longevity involves pronounced aging signs alongside traits protecting against aging's harmful consequences.
takeaways: Most comprehensive biological investigation yet of a supercentenarian
Multi-omic analysis used genomic, proteomic, epigenomic, metabolomic, microbiomic data
Branyas had very short telomeres and pro-inflammatory immune system, yet low actual inflammation
Epigenetic biological age younger than chronological age of 117
Gut microbiome dominated by beneficial bifidobacteria
Published in Cell Reports Medicine

events.title: SimpleDesign: joint generative model for protein sequence and structure design
events.one_liner: Apple Machine Learning Research published SimpleDesign, a generative model that jointly designs protein sequences and 3D structures in a single end-to-end training process. The model captures the intrinsic relationship between amino acid sequences and structures using Transformer-based multimodal architecture trained on over 2 million sequence-structure pairs.
takeaways: Single-stage end-to-end training directly in data space, unlike multi-stage autoencoder approaches
Trained on over 2 million sequence-structure pairs
Uses Transformer multimodal backbones with discrete cross-entropy loss for sequences and regression for structures
Achieved competitive performance on co-design and unconditional generation benchmarks
Published September 2026
